text.div:
قدرات منصة غولا الصحية FHIR R4

منصة غولا الصحية للمختبرات — نظام معلومات المختبرات الطبية (LIS)

GULA Medical Laboratory Platform — FHIR R4 Implementation

name: GULAPlatformFHIRCapability
title: GULA Platform FHIR R4 Capability Statement
title_ar: قدرات FHIR R4 لمنصة غولا الصحية
description: CapabilityStatement for the GULA Medical Laboratory Platform FHIR R4 implementation. The platform exposes 17 FHIR R4 resource types: Patient, Practitioner, Organization, Encounter, Observation, DiagnosticReport, Specimen, ServiceRequest, Device, Bundle, Condition, MedicationRequest, MedicationStatement, AllergyIntolerance, Immunization, CarePlan, DocumentReference, Composition, and Procedure. Authentication is via JWT Bearer tokens (HS256) with per-lab tenant isolation and role-based access control. Arabic-first bilingual platform (ar/en).
description_ar: وصف قدرات FHIR R4 لمنصة غولا الصحية للمختبرات. توفر المنصة 17 نوع من موارد FHIR R4. تشمل الموارد: المريض والممارس الصحي والمنظمة والزيارة والملاحظة والتقرير التشخيصي والعينة وطلب الخدمة والجهاز والحزمة والحالة وطلب الدواء وبيان الدواء والحساسية والتحصين وخطة الرعاية ومرجع المستند والتأليف والإجراء. المصادقة عبر JWT Bearer مع عزل بيانات لكل مختبر والتحكم في الوصول على أساس الدور. منصة ثنائية اللغة (العربية / الإنجليزية) تدعم العربية أولاً.

implementation.description: GULA Medical Laboratory Information System (LIS) — Arabic-first healthcare platform for Iraqi medical laboratories
implementation.description_ar: نظام معلومات المختبرات الطبية — منصة غولا الصحية للمختبرات الطبية العراقية

fhir_endpoints.name: Government Compliance FHIR API
fhir_endpoints.description: Ministry of Health / NIC compliance endpoints for patient data access, lab result reporting, and diagnostic report retrieval. All endpoints are tenant-isolated per lab_id.
fhir_endpoints.description_ar: نقاط نهاية الامتثال الحكومي لوزارة الصحة / مركز البيانات الوطني للوصول إلى بيانات المرضى والإبلاغ عن نتائج المختبر.

fhir_endpoints.name: LIMS FHIR API
fhir_endpoints.description: Laboratory Information Management System FHIR resources for device, specimen, service-request, observation, and diagnostic-report access. Full laboratory workflow integration.
fhir_endpoints.description_ar: موارد FHIR لنظام معلومات المختبرات للوصول إلى الأجهزة والعينات وطلبات الخدمة والملاحظات التقارير التشخيصية.

fhir_endpoints.name: National FHIR Data Layer
fhir_endpoints.description: National health data FHIR mappers for Patient, Practitioner, Organization, Encounter, and Observation resources. Used for SNDHS-lite integration and cross-institution data exchange.
fhir_endpoints.description_ar: طبقة بيانات FHIR الوطنية لمخططات المريض والممارس الصحي والمنظمة والزيارة والملاحظة.

allowedCodeSystems.http://loinc.org: LOINC codes for laboratory test identification
allowedCodeSystems.http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v3: Observation interpretation codes (H, L, HH, LL, N, A)

purpose: Declare the FHIR R4 capabilities of the GULA Medical Laboratory Platform for interoperability with the Iraqi Ministry of Health (MoH), National Data Center (NIC), SNDHS-lite national health data system, and DHIS2 aggregate reporting. Supports laboratory workflow integration, government compliance auditing, clinical data exchange, and ISO 15189 quality indicator reporting.
purpose_ar: الإعلان عن قدرات FHIR R4 لمنصة غولا الصحية للمختبرات للتوافق مع وزارة الصحة العراقية ومركز البيانات الوطني ونظام SNDHS-lite الصحي الوطني و DHIS2.

rest.documentation: GULA Platform FHIR R4 RESTful API. All requests require JWT Bearer authentication. Tenant isolation is enforced via lab_id — users can only access data belonging to their lab. Arabic is first language; error messages are bilingual (ar/en).
rest.documentation_ar: واجهة RESTful FHIR R4 لمنصة غولا. جميع الطلبات تتطلب مصادقة JWT Bearer. يتم فرض عزل المختبرات عبر lab_id.

security.description: Authentication: JWT Bearer tokens (HS256 algorithm) with 8-hour access token TTL and 30-day refresh token TTL. Tokens are issued via /auth/login and refreshed via /auth/refresh. Role-based access control (RBAC) with 9 roles and 13 permissions. Per-lab tenant isolation — every query filters by lab_id. Production deployment uses HTTPS/TLS via nginx. Documentation (/docs, /redoc) requires admin JWT in production. Rate limiting: 10 requests/min for auth, 100 requests/min for API, 20 requests/min for upload. Additional security: CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, request body size limits (10 MB max), intrusion detection with automatic blocking, Fernet encryption for sensitive fields at rest, HMAC-SHA256 one-way national ID hashing.
security.description_ar: المصادقة: رموز JWT Bearer (خوارزمية HS256) مع صلاحية 8 ساعات لرمز الوصول و 30 يوماً لرمز التحديث. التحكم في الوصول على أساس الدور. عزل بيانات كل مختبر عبر lab_id.

resource.documentation: Patient resource — maps from Citizen (national registry) and Patient (LIMS) domain models. Exposed via compliance and national FHIR layers.

interaction.documentation: Read Patient by ID via GET /compliance/fhir/patient/{patient_id}
Search Patient via FHIRSearchEngine: identifier, name, birthdate, gender, phone, address

searchParam.name: identifier
searchParam.documentation: Patient identifier (health number, national ID hash)

searchParam.name: name
searchParam.documentation: Patient name (given, family, or full Arabic name)

operation.name: validate
operation.documentation: Validate Patient resource against REQUIRED_FIELDS and FHIRValidationEngine

resource.documentation: Practitioner resource — maps from national Practitioner domain model. Licensed healthcare providers with specialty and qualification data.

interaction.documentation: Read Practitioner by FHIR ID via FHIRPatientMapper / FHIRPractitionerMapper
Search Practitioner via FHIRSearchEngine: identifier, name

resource.documentation: Organization resource — maps from national Organization domain model. Healthcare facilities, laboratories, and government health entities with hierarchical parent relationships.

interaction.documentation: Read Organization by FHIR ID via FHIROrganizationMapper
Search Organization via FHIRSearchEngine: identifier, name, type

resource.documentation: Encounter resource — maps from national Encounter domain model. Clinical encounters including outpatient, inpatient, emergency, and virtual visits with ICD-10 diagnosis codes.

interaction.documentation: Read Encounter by FHIR ID via FHIREncounterMapper
Search Encounter via FHIRSearchEngine: patient, date, status

searchParam.name: status
searchParam.documentation: Encounter status (planned | in-progress | onleave | finished | cancelled | entered-in-error | unknown)

resource.documentation: Observation resource — maps from LIMS Result and LabResult models. Laboratory test observations with LOINC coding, quantitative values, qualitative values, reference ranges, and interpretation flags. Exposed via both compliance and LIMS endpoints.

interaction.documentation: Read Observation by ID via GET /lims/results/{result_id}/fhir
Search Observations by order_id via GET /compliance/fhir/observation/{order_id} (returns Bundle)

resource.documentation: DiagnosticReport resource — maps from LIMS LabReport model. Wraps all Observations from a single lab order into a single reportable document. Exposed via both compliance and LIMS endpoints.

interaction.documentation: Read DiagnosticReport by order_id via GET /compliance/fhir/diagnostic-report/{order_id} or by report_id via GET /lims/reports/{report_id}/fhir

searchParam.name: status
searchParam.documentation: DiagnosticReport status (registered | partial | preliminary | final | amended | cancelled)

resource.documentation: Specimen resource — maps from LIMS Specimen model. Laboratory specimens with barcode tracking, container type, collection details, storage location, and chain of custody status.

interaction.documentation: Read Specimen by ID via GET /lims/specimens/{specimen_id}/fhir

resource.documentation: ServiceRequest resource — maps from LIMS Order (request from /lims/orders/) and LabOrder (via /compliance). Represents a clinician's laboratory test order with accession number, priority, and ordering provider.

interaction.documentation: Read ServiceRequest by order_id via GET /compliance/fhir/service-request/{order_id} or GET /lims/orders/{order_id}/fhir

resource.documentation: Device resource — maps from LIMS Instrument model. Laboratory analyzers and instruments with serial numbers, model information, manufacturer data, software versions, and operational status.

interaction.documentation: Read Device by instrument_id via GET /lims/instruments/{instrument_id}/fhir

resource.documentation: Bundle resource — used for search result aggregation. Observation search returns a Bundle of type 'collection'. Uses FHIRBundle class with FHIRBundleEntry per resource.

interaction.documentation: Bundle is returned as a response wrapper for search operations; not directly read by ID

resource.documentation: Condition resource — maps from ConditionRecord and DiagnosisRecord models. Clinical conditions with ICD-10 codes, clinical status, and verification status.

interaction.documentation: Read Condition by ID via GET /fhir/Condition/{id}
Search Condition via GET /fhir/Condition: patient, encounter, clinical-status

resource.documentation: MedicationRequest resource — maps from MedicationRequest model. Prescriptions with dosage, route, dispense details.

interaction.documentation: Read MedicationRequest by ID via GET /fhir/MedicationRequest/{id}
Search MedicationRequest: patient, status

resource.documentation: MedicationStatement resource — maps from MedicationStatement model. Patient-reported or clinician-recorded medication use.

interaction.documentation: Read MedicationStatement by ID via GET /fhir/MedicationStatement/{id}
Search MedicationStatement: patient, status

resource.documentation: AllergyIntolerance resource — maps from AllergyIntolerance model. Patient allergies and adverse reactions.

interaction.documentation: Read AllergyIntolerance by ID via GET /fhir/AllergyIntolerance/{id}
Search AllergyIntolerance: patient, clinical-status

resource.documentation: Immunization resource — maps from ImmunizationRecord model. Vaccine administration records with dose tracking.

interaction.documentation: Read Immunization by ID via GET /fhir/Immunization/{id}
Search Immunization: patient, status

resource.documentation: CarePlan resource — maps from CarePlan model. Planned healthcare activities with goals and activities.

interaction.documentation: Read CarePlan by ID via GET /fhir/CarePlan/{id}
Search CarePlan: patient, status

resource.documentation: DocumentReference resource — maps from ClinicalAttachment model. Patient documents with content type, storage path, hash.

interaction.documentation: Read DocumentReference by ID via GET /fhir/DocumentReference/{id}
Search DocumentReference: patient, category

resource.documentation: Composition resource — maps from ClinicalNote model. Clinical notes in FHIR Composition format with sections.

interaction.documentation: Read Composition by ID via GET /fhir/Composition/{id}
Search Composition: patient, status

resource.documentation: Procedure resource — maps from ClinicalNote with procedure-related content. Performed procedures with body site, outcome, performer.

interaction.documentation: Read Procedure by ID via GET /fhir/Procedure/{id}
Search Procedure: patient, status
Search across resource types using FHIRSearchEngine with _count, _offset pagination
Read individual resource by ID

operation.name: validate-resource
operation.documentation: Validate a FHIR resource against GULA profile constraints using FHIRValidationEngine. Checks required fields, Patient identifier format, Encounter status validity, and resource-type-specific constraints.
operation.documentation_ar: التحقق من صحة مورد FHIR مقابل قيود ملف تعريف غولا.

operation.name: expand-valueset
operation.documentation: Expand a ValueSet by URL using FHIRTerminologyService. Supported: administrative-gender, encounter-status.

operation.name: validate-code
operation.documentation: Validate a code from a code system using FHIRTerminologyService.validate_code().
operation.documentation_ar: التحقق من صحة الرمز من نظام الترميز.
